title: Shared-Factor-Conditioned Diffusion for Low-Rank Tensor Recovery
title_zh: 共享因子条件扩散用于低秩张量恢复

paragraphs.en: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie’s formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR
paragraphs.zh: 张量恢复涵盖异构的数据结构与观测过程，因此需要一种能够跨模态、跨任务自适应的表示方法。 我们提出 DiffTR，这是一个无监督框架，通过坐标条件化的扩散模型统一了张量补全、去噪和高光谱超分辨率任务。 由张量坐标索引的共享因子对一个紧凑的得分网络进行条件化，得分匹配从可用观测中联合学习这些因子和一个隐式张量表示。 标量和向量值输出可以处理单个条目和整条管道，从而为表格张量、图像和视频提供统一的公式化表达。 该框架将表示学习与任务特定的观测建模分离开来：反向扩散用于恢复缺失值；基于 Tweedie 公式的估计、软阈值以及可选的空间一致性支持混合噪声去噪；测量引导的采样将从低分辨率高光谱观测中学到的先验迁移到高分辨率重建中，随后在采样后进行数据一致性和光谱子空间正则化的精化。 这种分离使该表示能够兼容不同的退化模型，并允许在同一恢复框架内融入任务特定的约束。 在多种张量模态和恢复任务上的实验表明，该方法具有竞争力的重建质量以及统一条件生成表示的灵活性。 代码已在 https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR 公开。

paragraphs.en: Tensor recovery estimates an underlying tensor from incomplete, corrupted, or indirect measurements. This problem arises in sparse multiway tables, continuous-time records, RGB images, multispectral images, hyperspectral images, and videos. Applications span completion [ 1 , 2 ] , denoising, spectral super-resolution, factor analysis [ 3 ] , sequence modeling [ 4 ] , model compression [ 5 , 6 ] , and generative modeling [ 7 , 8 ] . A general recovery framework must accommodate both heterogeneous structure and heterogeneous observations. Sparse tables encode interactions among discrete entities, whereas visual tensors exhibit spatial, spectral, and temporal correlations. Missing entries, missing tubes, mixed noise, and resolution loss impose different constraints on these structures. We use MSI and HSI to denote multispectral and hyperspectral images, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 张量恢复旨在从不完整、受污染或间接的测量中估计底层张量。 该问题出现在稀疏多路表、连续时间记录、RGB 图像、多光谱图像、高光谱图像和视频中。 其应用涵盖补全 [1, 2]、去噪、光谱超分辨率、因子分析 [3]、序列建模 [4]、模型压缩 [5, 6] 以及生成建模 [7, 8]。 一个通用的恢复框架必须同时兼容异质结构与异质观测。 稀疏表编码离散实体之间的交互，而视觉张量则表现出空间、光谱和时间上的相关性。 缺失条目、缺失管道、混合噪声和分辨率损失对这些结构施加了不同的约束。 我们用 MSI 和 HSI 分别表示多光谱图像和高光谱图像。

paragraphs.en: Classical low-rank tensor recovery combines a tensor representation, an observation model, and an optimization procedure. CP [ 9 ] , Tucker [ 10 ] , tensor train [ 11 ] , tensor ring [ 12 ] , and tensor networks such as fully connected and tensor wheel decompositions [ 13 , 14 ] prescribe how latent factors or cores are contracted into tensor entries. Structure search improves the representation by adapting network topology and mode assignments [ 15 , 16 ] , but the resulting model still relies on an explicit contraction. Many methods based on implicit neural representations (INRs) extend tensor models with fixed contraction structures to continuous domains [ 17 , 18 ] . Their effectiveness therefore depends on matching the contraction structure to the data, which can be challenging when spatial, spectral, temporal, and entity-level dependencies differ across modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 经典低秩张量恢复将张量表示、观测模型和优化过程结合在一起。 CP [ 9 ]、Tucker [ 10 ]、张量链 [ 11 ]、张量环 [ 12 ]，以及全连接和张量轮等张量网络分解 [ 13 , 14 ] 规定了潜在因子或核心如何收缩为张量条目。 结构搜索通过调整网络拓扑和模态分配来改进表示 [ 15 , 16 ]，但所得模型仍依赖于显式收缩。 许多基于隐式神经表示（INR）的方法将具有固定收缩结构的张量模型扩展到连续域 [ 17 , 18 ]。 因此，其有效性取决于收缩结构与数据的匹配程度，而当空间、光谱、时间和实体级别的依赖关系在不同模态之间存在差异时，这可能具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: CoSTCo and POND address the restrictions of multilinear interactions through convolutional networks and Gaussian processes with neural kernels, respectively [ 19 , 20 ] . Energy-based tensor models learn entry–factor compatibility without prescribed contractions, but primarily operate on scalar entries [ 21 , 22 ] . Extending these formulations to joint tube recovery and indirect measurements requires corresponding treatment of vector-valued outputs and observation constraints. Building on these advances, we seek a common conditional diffusion framework that accommodates heterogeneous tensor modalities, scalar entries and vector-valued tubes, and task-specific observation models across completion, denoising, and HSI super-resolution.
paragraphs.zh: CoSTCo 和 POND 分别通过卷积网络和带神经核的高斯过程来应对多重线性交互的限制 [ 19 , 20 ] 。 基于能量的张量模型无需预设收缩即可学习条目—因子兼容性，但主要作用于标量条目 [ 21 , 22 ] 。 将这些公式扩展到联合管道恢复与间接测量，需要对向量值输出和观测约束进行相应的处理。 在这些进展的基础上，我们寻求一个统一的条件扩散框架，以兼容异构张量模态、标量条目与向量值管道，以及涵盖补全、去噪和高光谱图像（HSI）超分辨率的任务特定观测模型。

paragraphs.en: We introduce DiffTR , a diffusion framework conditioned on coordinate-indexed tensor factors. For each mode, an R R -dimensional factor vector is associated with every index or coordinate, either retrieved from a factor matrix for discrete modes or generated by an implicit neural representation for continuous modes. Atoms that share an index within the same mode reuse the corresponding factor vector, so that their observations jointly inform its learning. The resulting factor vectors are concatenated to condition a score network. Here, an atom refers to a scalar entry or a vector-valued tube, indexed by its positions across the modes. Denoising score matching jointly learns the factors and the conditional score, and reverse diffusion recovers the target atoms. We define the representation rank R R as the feature dimension of each factor vector. By learning interactions among factors, the score network provides a flexible alternative to prescribed multilinear contractions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 DiffTR，一种以坐标索引张量因子为条件的扩散框架。 对于每个模态，每个索引或坐标都关联一个 R R 维的因子向量，该向量要么从离散模态的因子矩阵中检索得到，要么由连续模态的隐式神经表示生成。 在同一模态中共享某个索引的原子会复用对应的因子向量，从而使它们的观测共同作用于该向量的学习。 由此得到的因子向量被拼接起来，用于对一个分数网络进行条件化。 这里，原子指一个标量条目或一个向量值的海量切片（tube），由其在各模态上的位置进行索引。 去噪分数匹配联合学习各因子与条件分数，反向扩散则恢复目标原子。 我们将表示秩 R R 定义为每个因子向量的特征维度。 通过学习因子之间的交互，分数网络为预设的多重线性收缩提供了一种灵活的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: DiffTR adopts a unified coordinate-conditioned diffusion formulation for completion, denoising, and HSI super-resolution, with learning and recovery procedures tailored to the available observations. For completion, it learns from observed entries or tubes and generates the missing ones. For denoising, it alternates score learning, clean-value estimation via Tweedie’s formula, and sparse-noise separation, with optional spatial consistency enforcement. For HSI super-resolution, it learns from the upsampled LR-HSI, guides reverse diffusion with HR-MSI measurements, and applies post-sampling refinement to improve data consistency. Each tensor is trained on its own observations, and the number of diffusion steps can be adjusted according to its structure and recovery requirements.
paragraphs.zh: DiffTR采用统一的坐标条件扩散公式来完成补全、去噪和高光谱图像（HSI）超分辨率任务，并根据可用的观测数据定制学习与恢复过程。 对于补全，它从已观测的条目或管状结构中学习，并生成缺失的部分。 对于去噪，它交替进行分数学习、通过Tweedie公式估计干净值以及稀疏噪声分离，并可选择实施空间一致性约束。 对于高光谱图像超分辨率，它从上采样后的低分辨率高光谱图像中学习，利用高分辨率多光谱图像（HR-MSI）观测引导反向扩散，并在采样后进行精细化处理以提升数据一致性。 每个张量都基于自身的观测数据进行训练，扩散步数可根据其结构和恢复需求进行调整。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We formulate tensor recovery as conditional diffusion over scalar entries or vector-valued tubes, where shared mode-wise factors condition a score network that learns factor interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将张量恢复表述为对标量条目或向量值管道的条件扩散，其中共享的模态因子对一个学习因子交互的评分网络进行条件化。

paragraphs.en: We develop an extensible, unsupervised framework that learns from each tensor’s own observations and supports completion, denoising, and HSI super-resolution across tabular, image, and video tensors via task-specific observation models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出一个可扩展的无监督框架，它从每个张量自身的观测中学习，并通过任务特定的观测模型，支持对表格、图像和视频张量进行补全、去噪和高光谱图像（HSI）超分辨率处理。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DiffTR across tensor modalities and recovery tasks, demonstrating competitive reconstruction quality and analyzing the effects of key components and computational cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多种张量模态和恢复任务上评估了 DiffTR，展示了具有竞争力的重建质量，并分析了关键组件和计算开销的影响。

paragraphs.en: Tensor completion exploits dependencies among modes to infer missing values. Classical approaches use CP, Tucker, and tensor-network factorizations [ 9 , 12 , 13 ] , unfolding-based trace norms [ 23 ] , or tensor-tensor-product models [ 24 ] . Recent work combines low-rank Tucker factor priors with spatial–spectral graph regularization to capture global correlations and nonlinear manifold structure in HSI completion [ 25 ] . Bayesian and nonparametric methods incorporate rank adaptation, nonlinear interactions, and uncertainty [ 26 , 1 , 20 , 27 ] , while continuous-time models capture temporal variation through splines or neural dynamics [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] . Neural methods learn factor-to-value mappings, continuous tensor functions, frequency-aware representations, and deep latent parameterizations [ 19 , 17 , 31 , 32 , 18 ] . EnergyTD and ScoreTR further introduce implicit distributional modeling [ 21 , 22 ] .

paragraphs.en: Existing formulations typically target specific output units or coordinate domains, making it difficult to jointly support scalar entries, vector-valued tubes, and side information. Prescribed contractions can also restrict expressiveness when their structure poorly matches the dependencies in different tensor modalities. DiffTR addresses these limitations by supporting scalar and tube-valued atoms within a unified conditional diffusion formulation. Mode-wise factors are retrieved for discrete indices or generated by INRs for continuous coordinates, including timestamps. A conditional score network learns their interactions without prescribing a multilinear contraction.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的表述通常针对特定的输出单元或坐标域，难以同时支持标量条目、向量值管和张量侧信息。 当预设的收缩结构难以匹配不同张量模态中的依赖关系时，也会限制表达能力。 DiffTR 通过在统一的条件扩散表述中同时支持标量原子和管值原子，解决了这些局限。 对于离散索引，按模态逐一分量地检索因子；对于包括时间戳在内的连续坐标，则由 INR 生成因子。 条件得分网络学习这些因子之间的交互，而无需预设多线性收缩。

paragraphs.en: The effectiveness of these methods depends on how well their structural priors and noise assumptions match the data. Mixed-noise recovery requires coordinated treatment of dense noise and sparse outliers, since fitting corrupted values directly can embed noise in the learned representation. DiffTR alternates score learning, clean-value estimation via Tweedie’s formula, and sparse-noise separation by soft thresholding. An optional spatial-consistency loss penalizes score differences at nearby coordinates, incorporating local smoothness into the same conditional representation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法的有效性取决于其结构先验和噪声假设与数据的匹配程度。 混合噪声恢复需要对稠密噪声和稀疏离群点进行协同处理，因为直接拟合受损值会将噪声嵌入所学表示中。 DiffTR 交替执行分数学习、通过 Tweedie 公式进行的干净值估计，以及通过软阈值进行的稀疏噪声分离。 一个可选的空间一致性损失会惩罚相邻坐标处的分数差异，从而将局部平滑性融入同一条件表示中。

paragraphs.en: HSI super-resolution combines the spectral information of an LR-HSI with the spatial information of an HR-MSI. Coupled tensor methods share latent structure between the two observations [ 39 , 40 ] . Other approaches employ generalized tensor nuclear norms [ 41 ] , nonlinear transforms [ 42 ] , or self-supervised decomposition networks [ 43 ] . Fang et al. estimate spatial coefficients in an LR-HSI-derived spectral subspace using a spatial-frequency network and data-fidelity refinement [ 44 ] . Diffusion and score-based models offer generative priors [ 45 , 46 ] , while diffusion posterior sampling uses measurements to guide reverse diffusion [ 47 ] .

paragraphs.en: We next consider two timestamped tensors. Air is the Beijing air-quality dataset [ 51 ] , containing approximately 10 4 10^{4} observations over 12 12 sites and 6 6 pollutants. Click is an advertising click-through tensor [ 29 ] with 7 7 banner positions, 2842 2842 site domains, and 4127 4127 mobile applications, and contains approximately 5 × 10 4 5\times 10^{4} timestamped observations. We follow the split of [ 29 ] and report five-fold cross-validation results. paragraphs.en: Tables III and IV show that DiffTR achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and NRMSE across all 30 combinations of modality, sampling rate, and observation pattern. For tube-wise MSI recovery, it outperforms FA-INR by 2.63–2.80 dB across the tested sampling rates. The reconstructions in Figure 2 further illustrate its preservation of object boundaries and local detail. Together, these results demonstrate that DiffTR effectively recovers both missing entries and tubes across diverse tensor modalities within a common conditional diffusion formulation.

paragraphs.en: The ablations demonstrate how the shared representation accommodates coordinate information, corruption models, spatial constraints, and spectral measurements. Their task-dependent effects motivate task-specific observation models within a common recovery framework.

paragraphs.en: We introduced DiffTR, a unified tensor recovery framework built on shared-factor-conditioned score learning. The same representation supports scalar entries and vector-valued tubes, while task-specific observation models extend recovery from completion to mixed-noise denoising and HSI super-resolution. Likelihood fitting and proximal correction accommodate corruption models, and optional spatial consistency provides a coordinate-based alternative to TV. Experiments across tabular tensors, images, and videos demonstrate the framework’s broad applicability, competitive recovery quality, and efficient neural representation. This separation of representation learning and observation modeling provides a foundation for extending DiffTR to additional tensor structures and inverse problems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 DiffTR，一个基于共享因子条件化分数学习的统一张量恢复框架。 同一表示同时支持标量条目和向量值管道，而任务特定的观测模型将恢复从补全扩展到混合噪声去噪和高光谱图像（HSI）超分辨率。 似然拟合与近端校正可适应各种腐蚀模型，可选的空间一致性提供了基于坐标的 TV 替代方案。 在表格张量、图像和视频上的实验表明，该框架具有广泛的适用性、有竞争力的恢复质量以及高效的神经表示。 这种表示学习与观测建模的分离为进一步将 DiffTR 扩展到更多张量结构和逆问题奠定了基础。

paragraphs.en: Baselines receive DiffTR’s measured initialization-and-training time for each scene and setting. CS2DIPs selects the lowest observed-data Huber loss within 5,000 updates; GTNN and GNLTN allow up to 100 and 50 iterations. Their implementations use Lloyd clustering, bicubic initialization, matched degradation operators, and CPU LAPACK SVD for selected operations. EDIP-Net allocates 2 / 9 2/9 of its budget to stage two (at most 4,000 updates) and the remainder to stage three; learning rate 0.004 is constant for half of each phase, then decays linearly. Allocation rules and architectures are fixed, and retained outputs satisfy both time and iteration limits.
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法采用 DiffTR 在每个场景和设置下实测的初始化与训练时间。 CS2DIPs 在 5,000 次更新内选取观测数据 Huber 损失最低的结果；GTNN 和 GNLTN 分别允许最多 100 次和 50 次迭代。 它们的实现使用 Lloyd 聚类、双三次初始化、匹配的退化算子，并对所选操作使用 CPU 上的 LAPACK SVD。 EDIP-Net 将其预算的 2 / 9 2/9 分配给第二阶段（最多 4,000 次更新），其余分配给第三阶段；学习率 0.004 在每个阶段的前半段保持恒定，随后线性衰减。 分配规则与架构保持固定，保留的输出同时满足时间与迭代次数限制。

paragraphs.en: Profiling uses RTX 3090 GPUs, two CPU threads, one process per device, a three-second warm-up, and CUDA-synchronized timing. Baselines have T rec = T opt T_{\rm rec}=T_{\rm opt} ; DiffTR also includes basis estimation, operator setup, sampling, and refinement. Training and inference may use different GPUs of the same model. Loading, evaluation, and file I/O are excluded. Parameter counts cover network weights, including both EDIP-Net networks, but exclude optimized inputs, EMA copies, optimizer states, and buffers. Peak GPU memory is the largest allocated value per dataset; DiffTR uses the larger training or standalone-inference peak after releasing the optimizer. CUDA context memory, unused allocator reservations, and CPU SVD memory are excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 性能剖析使用 RTX 3090 GPU、两个 CPU 线程、每个设备一个进程、三秒预热，以及 CUDA 同步计时。 基线的 T rec = T opt T_{\rm rec}=T_{\rm opt}；DiffTR 还包括基估计、算子设置、采样和细化。 训练和推理可以使用同一型号的不同 GPU。 加载、评估和文件 I/O 均被排除。 参数量统计覆盖网络权重，包括两个 EDIP-Net 网络，但不包括优化后的输入、EMA 副本、优化器状态和缓冲区。 峰值 GPU 显存是每个数据集的最大分配值；DiffTR 在释放优化器后，采用训练或独立推理中较大的峰值。 CUDA 上下文显存、未使用的分配器预留以及 CPU SVD 内存均被排除。
